about: The mutant runner shares the capped-child classifier with proclimit.

mutants.name: embed-duplicate-ledger-anchor
mutants.rule: Every ledger edit applies exactly once at HEAD, including literal template edits.

mutants.name: gcoom-mutants-text-only
mutants.rule: A capped mutant child's span-queue allocation fault has reason memory.

mutants.name: mutclean-copy-without-git
mutants.rule: The runner's copy carries the checkout's Git file list, so a test that reads the repository (git ls-files) can kill a mutant.

mutants.name: mutclean-other-package-killer-dropped
mutants.from: return Suite{Name: name, Package: "./" + dir, Tags: tags}, nil, true
mutants.rule: A killer in another package of the module (DIR or DIR[TAGS]) is a suite the runner runs, so no row is run by hand.

mutants.name: mutclean-ergo-suite-killer-dropped
mutants.rule: A package ledger's killer named by an ergo suite (lower, std, examples) runs in that suite, with its tools.

mutants.name: mutnames-unresolved-suite-skipped
mutants.from: unresolved = append(unresolved, fmt.Errorf("%s: mutant %q: %q names no suite
mutants.to: _ = append(unresolved, fmt.Errorf("%s: mutant %q: %q names no suite
mutants.rule: A killer or anchor id whose suite resolves to nothing is an error of the ledger, never a killer the runner leaves out.

mutants.name: mutnames-missing-test-accepted
mutants.rule: A killer or anchor id names a test its suite has (a Test func of the package, an example program); a renamed or deleted test is an error of the ledger.

mutants.name: mutnames-ledger-env-dropped
mutants.rule: A package ledger's env is the environment of every run of its own suite, so a plain runner invocation judges killers that need a switch (tsproj's ERGO_TS_TEST=1).

mutants.name: mutnames-ergo-ledger-env-accepted
mutants.rule: check's and lower's ledgers share the ergo suites; an env there is refused, not dropped or spread to every suite.

mutants.name: mutnames-plain-rerun-dropped
mutants.rule: A test that fails only when its binary is built with coverage (a sandboxed self-run) and passes without stays a killer; it is not dropped as failing on the unmutated tree.

mutants.name: mutnames-no-test-timeout
mutants.rule: A Go test binary runs with a -test.timeout, as under go test, so a test that bounds its children by t.Deadline judges mutants.
